title: Merge Protocol
definition: The safe procedure for combining multiple LoRA adapters into the base model to create a deployable GGUF.

difficulty_levels.beginner: The method for combining different parts (adapters) of a large language model to create a single, functioning model.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A process for merging multiple LoRA adapters (safetensors) into the base model using the llama-export-lora tool, resulting in a deployable GGUF.
difficulty_levels.expert: The protocol for efficiently and safely merging multiple LoRA adapters into the base model to create a deployable GGUF without causing catastrophic forgetting, using a specific scale factor and test commands for verification.

extra_fields.insight: The novel method for merging multiple adapters into the base model in a single command, preserving reasoning ability, and ensuring scalability and efficiency.
